messages.content: What's the average temperature for Los Angeles in December?

function.name: calculate_bmi
function.description: Calculates the Body Mass Index given person's weight and height. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

weight.description: The weight of the person in kilograms. This is a float type value.

height.description: The height of the person in meters. This is a float type value.

unit.description: Unit for calculation, either metric or imperial. Default is metric

message.content:
In December, Los Angeles enjoys mild winter weather. On average:

| Metric | Imperial |
|--------|----------|
| Average high | ~20 °C (68 °F) |
| Average low | ~12 °C (54 °F) |
| Typical daily mean | ~16 °C (61 °F) |

So you can expect daytime temperatures in the mid‑60s °F (around 18–20 °C) and nighttime lows in the upper 50s °F (≈12 °C).
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What's the average temperature for Los Angeles in December?" We need to provide an answer. There's no tool needed. Just respond with the average temperature. According to typical climate data, average high around 20°C (68°F) and low around 12°C (54°F). But we can give approximate average daily temperature maybe around 16°C (61°F). Let's give both metric and imperial. Provide context.
